branch_purpose: A three-state geometrical crossbridge model with fixed chemical affinity, free/weak/strong states, binding access from head geometry, reverse reaction rates, energy-consistent state forces, steric confinement force, and shared-free-state competition among periodic sites. A 1 nm by 1 nm model cycle predicts total fixed-registry work +0.17333 pN nm at (10,14) nm and -1.36843 pN nm at (10,16) nm. Uniform registry averaging predicts +0.0409348 pN nm per motor at mean gap 14 nm and -0.0934483 at 16 nm; mean axial force remains contractile at both. The stated computations and source corrections are not acquired measurements.

assumptions: The specified source implementation constants and three-state continuous-time chemical model define the calculation.
Two independent relative coordinates and a fixed motor-base reference are imposed in the model, not supplied by an acquired scaffold.
Uniform registry averaging assumes the stated periodic site geometry and shared free state.
